_comment: Append newest entries at the top of `updates`. Each needs a unique `id`. Optional `image` is a path under /assets/. Keep entries public-safe: no Pets/Brainrot, no admin-only or subscription marketing.

updates.title: Geo Chess: play other players
updates.body: Challenge a classmate by gamertag right inside Geo Chess — no separate Chess Duel. Bot games and friend matches both update your Chess Elo (prior wins convert into a starting rating).

updates.title: Cooking… while you wait
updates.body: Loading screens across LearnGeo now simmer with a little pot animation and a “cooking” caption — games, maps, Learn, and more.

updates.title: Geo Chess Elo & leaderboard
updates.body: Geo Chess now has a Chess Elo rating (starts at 1000). Finished bot and friend games update your rating, and the Games leaderboard ranks Elo instead of win counts.

updates.title: Achievement cards
updates.body: Flip through your achievements like a stack of cards, then send unlocked ones to classmates by gamertag — school-safe sharing, no real money.

updates.title: Geo Chess: openings & tougher bots
updates.body: After a few moves you’ll see the opening name. Pawn promotion and the usual chess rules are clearer, and you can challenge Grandmaster (~3200) or Engine Max.

updates.title: More Games cosmetics
updates.body: Customise → Games now covers Geo Chess boards and pieces, Capital Snake coils, Flag Match tile backs, Capital Maze explorers, and Geo Duel accents — alongside Geo Dash trails and jumpers.

updates.title: Chess Duel: challenge a friend
updates.body: Invite a classmate by gamertag to a live chess match — same invite inbox as Geo Duel, then take turns on a shared board. Host plays White.

updates.title: Rivers & lakes in Select
updates.body: Study filters now include rivers and lakes alongside countries, capitals, and flags — turn them on when you set what to practise.

updates.title: Border Crossing: clearer gates
updates.body: The crossing gates now sit below the question sign, so the prompt stays readable while you pick a gate.

updates.title: Hidden secrets & badge case
updates.body: Twelve new secrets to find around LearnGeo, with rewards and a badge case section so you can show what you’ve unlocked.

updates.title: Smoother difficulty sliders
updates.body: Study and game difficulty controls got clearer ticks, a steadier thumb, and a light tick sound when you change levels.

updates.title: Games hub & leaderboards
updates.body: The arcade hub is easier to browse, and every game has a leaderboard so you can see how you stack up.
